review_kind: Independent read-only new W2 publicCPU/ICB/driver closure review; no re-review/acceptance of W2 arithmetic core

conclusions.observation: Driver performs BEGIN/X then tile0 OPEN/W/b/COMMIT and immediately START; later OPENs are emitted only after START event in the same ordered stream. Actual red-only run executes unchanged fullW preload-all schedule against W2, obtains core error0x12/CPU-11 and real Verilator-6, with current source hashes. No D3 CPU PASS is reused.

Adapter is byte-equivalent to D3 apart from namespace/core selection: response readiness never depends on core/input slot. Full COMMIT reports immediate error. During every emit poll driver first drains at most one available Y then tests event capacity. When thirdOPEN is core-deferred and followingW waits in adapter, CPU status/Y/POP remain usable and eventually release old slot. Small2tasks does not exercise this full-slot condition; full run explicitly requires deferredOPEN and POP-with-pending-input in each cold task before PASS.

Driver uses original Wq_packed[n,k] data but streams each tile as k*16+col with w[(tile*16+col)*64+k], matching W2 public layout. Physical slot ID remains private; adapter forwards tile/index/data without address transform. Bias48 payload uses high16/low32 staging as in accepted driver.

Driver checks task/index/duplicate/last, writes destination[y_index] and flags[y_index], fences thenPOPs. W2 TB checks every actual shared Y/flag command and byte mask, unique coverage, matched write responses and complete final SRAM. Small actual CPU emits192Y+192flags across2independent3x32tasks and both commands/actual writes pass.

core done remains sticky accelerator fact. Final system_done is only TB observation on successful CPU BOOT mailbox write response, after every expected Y/flags write response; C handles fault before done. New short bus/completion TBs actually pass current source and cover response backpressure/reset and illegal queued event around finalY capture/accept/retire. No hardware system_done output is newly claimed.

Current smallCPU run includes nonzero-return, zero-return/no-work and one-bit incorrect verifier-only expected result. Each actual compiled CPU binary simulation fails via intended Verilator fatal(-6), not timeout. These are CPU/software negative controls, not additional W2 coreRTL mutation credit.

No additional state transform exists in adapter, so same-edge core COMMIT/oldY and slot switching use the established W2 stream semantics. Adapter short boundary tests useN16 and do not claim a distinct two-slot CPU COMMIT/oldtileY simultaneous-hit count; fullCPU lifecycle counters prove progress/ownership at their measured scope, while existing core-directed same-edge case remains separate evidence.
